summary: Backend-only regression + new-feature testing for alpha-fit. 47/47 tests pass (24 baseline + 23 new). Covered heartbeat & admin online tracking, activity feed (register/onboarding/workout events), workout stats, progression suggestion (with & without history), first_workout badge logic, full support ticket lifecycle (create/list/respond/delete) + 403 for non-admin, nutrition (today/log/history/delete), GPT-5.2 Vision food-photo analyze with a real Unsplash food image (returns valid JSON with all required fields), coach chat, Stripe LIVE checkout session creation, admin stats with online_users + revenue. Existing 24-test baseline still green (no regression).

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 if LLM JSON parsing fails (no fallback to current plan). Onboarding has fallback_plan(); adjust-plan does not. Consider mirroring the fallback for resilience.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set in backend/.env so the webhook silently falls back to unsigned payloads (json.loads of raw body). This is a security risk in production - any attacker reaching /api/webhook/stripe can forge checkout.session.completed and grant premium.
Returns 500 if GPT JSON is unparseable. Reasonable but could provide a graceful fallback or 422 with a clearer client-friendly message.
Cascading delete removes workout_sessions/training_plans/chat_messages but NOT nutrition_entries, support_tickets, payment_transactions, activity_events. Orphan data accumulates.
No 404 check if ticket_id doesn't exist - update_one matched_count is not validated; silently returns ok=true.

action_items: Add fallback handling in /api/coach/adjust-plan when LLM JSON parsing fails (mirror onboarding's fallback_plan pattern).
Configure STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in backend/.env and ensure the webhook handler always verifies signature in production.
Extend admin_delete_member to also purge nutrition_entries, support_tickets, payment_transactions, activity_events for the user (or anonymize) to avoid orphan data.
Validate ticket existence (matched_count) in admin_respond_ticket and admin_delete_ticket; return 404 otherwise.
Consider splitting server.py (1413 lines) into routers: auth, coach, sessions, nutrition, support, admin, payments - exceeds the 700-line guideline by 2x.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1413 lines - significantly over the 700-line guideline. Routers should be split for maintainability.
is_premium_active() silently treats malformed premium_until/trial_until ISO strings as 'not premium' (broad except). Could mask data corruption.
Activity feed has no index on user_id/created_at - will degrade as collection grows.
/api/nutrition/analyze + /api/coach/chat have no rate limiting; LLM calls are expensive and a malicious user can drain the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget.
calculate_streak() does datetime.fromisoformat on a YYYY-MM-DD string slice [:10] which works but is brittle (relies on completed_at always being UTC ISO).
Support ticket length caps (subject 200, message 5000) are silently truncated rather than rejected with 400 - user gets no feedback.
Admin endpoints rely on is_admin flag but no audit log for destructive ops (delete user, grant premium). Consider logging into activity_events.

is_premium field in DB is decoupled from is_premium_active() - DB may say is_premium=true even when premium_until is expired; admin_stats counts on is_premium flag (line 996) so it can over-report premium users.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend flows green including GPT-5.2 Vision (Unsplash food image -> full nutrition JSON in ~10s) and Stripe LIVE checkout. STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET still missing. admin_stats.premium_users uses the boolean is_premium flag (not the time-aware is_premium_active), so revoked-but-not-yet-expired-cleared accounts can inflate the count - worth a follow-up if accuracy matters. Two test suites: backend/tests/backend_test.py (baseline 24) and backend/tests/test_new_features.py (new 23). Run both for full coverage.
